patch_description: Replaces the single local smoother with a structured multiscale pipeline: three endpoint-aligned weighted regressions produce causal level, slope, and residual-noise estimates; confidence-driven blending selects faster recent weighting during reliable trends and gentler weighting during noisy/flat intervals. A robust adaptive alpha-beta tracking stage then applies innovation clipping, acceleration limiting, and direction hysteresis to reduce false reversals while retaining low-lag trend tracking. Shared validation and regression helpers improve maintainability while preserving all original public inputs and outputs.
